correctness.rationale: For char k≠2, write X_i=a_i I+v_i, v_i in traceless 3D split quadratic space with Q=z^2+xy. Anticommutation gives vector a_i v_j+a_j v_i=0 and scalar a_i a_j+B(v_i,v_j)=0. Three nonzero scalar traces force contradiction; exactly one trace gives coordinate pieces, exactly two give the smooth norm-one two-support surface. All zero traces reduce to pairwise orthogonal frames in dimension three; the proof stratifies rank-three supported triples, degenerate rank-two planes using an isotropic line incidence bundle, and lower ranks. A proper projective incidence projection establishes closedness and irreducibility of m+2-dimensional strata. The exact odd-q count combines q+1 isotropic lines, orthogonal anisotropic pairs/triples and traceful strata, with nonzero m^1 q^m and m^3 coefficients establishing minimal recurrence (T-q)^2(T-1)^4. Direct independent F3 anticommutator counts matched N2=417,N3=1521; finite data are not the arbitrary-field proof.
